summary: "Wyrding Women's Rhythmic Immersion" is a six-class frame drum instructional series taught by Brandi Mizilca, a professional dancer/drummer/healing-arts practitioner, held at The Well (associated with Arts2People) in Asheville. "Wyrding women" is descriptive language for the participants ("female and female-identifying humans"), not the name of a pre-existing standing group; the listing frames it as a paid, enrollment-based class with a minimum headcount, not an ongoing circle with independent membership.

evidence.note: 5 weekly listings (2026-03-30 to 2026-04-27) all describe the same instructional series ('hands-on frame drum instruction... technique drills, listening practice') rather than an independent recurring meetup.
Full page text confirms it is a six-class series, $120/person, minimum 10 enrollees to run, taught by named instructor Brandi Mizilca at 3 Louisiana Ave (The Well).

General web search for 'Wyrding Women' Asheville and 'Wyrding Women' frame drum returns no independent website, Facebook group/page, Meetup, or Instagram for a standing collective by this name; all hits trace back to this same class listing or unrelated frame-drumming resources.

No membership language (dues, sign-up roster, named regulars, Discord/newsletter) found anywhere; the copy addresses prospective students, not existing members, and 'wyrding women' reads as a description of participants rather than a proper group name.
